name: 最终幻境
english_description: The Final Frontier (FF), a space-opera science-fiction MUD adapted from the 'Dongfang Gushi II' (Eastern Story II, ES2) codebase, founded by Spock — a rare sci-fi reskin within this collection's ES II/Eastern Story family, rather than the usual wuxia setting. Its save data was originally Traditional Chinese (BIG5) and has been converted to UTF-8.
